masteryZone.q: On the banks of which river did Vardhamana Mahavira attain Kaivalya?
masteryZone.sol: Vardhamana Mahavira attained Kaivalya on the banks of the Rijupalika River near Jrimbhikagrama. Niranjana is where Buddha attained enlightenment.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Vardhamana Mahavira was born in Lumbini.
masteryZone.sol: False. Vardhamana Mahavira was born in Kundagrama near Vaishali (Bihar). Buddha was born in Lumbini.

masteryZone.q: The concept of relative truth/maybe in Jainism is known as:
masteryZone.sol: Syadvada is the theory of conditioned/relative judgments, often translated as the theory of 'maybe' or 'in some ways' (Saptabhanginaya).

masteryZone.q: The fifth great vow added by Mahavira is ________.
masteryZone.sol: Brahmacharya (celibacy) was added by Vardhamana Mahavira. The first four were given by Parshvanatha.

masteryZone.q: In which language was the early Jain canonical literature composed?
masteryZone.sol: The early Jain canonical scriptures (Angas) were written in Ardhamagadhi Prakrit, helping them reach the common populace.

masteryZone.q: Who wrote the Sanskrit work Kalpasutra, containing biographies of Tirthankaras?
Where was the Second Jain Council held around 512 AD?
masteryZone.sol: The Second Jain Council was held at Vallabhi in Gujarat under the presidency of Devardhi Kshamashramana.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The compilation of the 12 Angas took place at the First Jain Council in Pataliputra.
masteryZone.sol: True. The First Council at Pataliputra, presided over by Sthulabhadra, resulted in the compilation of the 12 Angas.

masteryZone.q: Which sect of Jainism is associated with Bhadrabahu and absolute nudity?
masteryZone.sol: The Digambara (sky-clad) sect led by Bhadrabahu rejects clothing and maintains strict ascetic orthodox practices.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The Dilwara marble temples are located in Mount Abu, Rajasthan.
masteryZone.sol: True. The famous Dilwara marble temples are built on Mount Abu, showcasing exquisite Solanki era architecture.
